name: K-planes
definition: A white-box model for radiance fields in arbitrary dimensions d that uses planar factorization to represent a d-dimensional scene. It uses k = d choose 2 planes to represent every pair of dimensions, providing a compact, interpretable representation that scales gracefully with dimension.
summary: K-planes is an interpretable neural representation for radiance fields that decomposes scenes into 2D planes multiplied element-wise, enabling high compression and fast optimization.
